items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: I mean Ronnie Dio was from Cortland. I mean Ronnie Padavona, but he went with Ronnie Dio.

ctx.x: I’m talking of high school, yeah.

I was just gone. I mean I think a couple of them thought that my girlfriend might be available which wasn’t the case. But I guess so. I guess they could have been jealous. But they — see I was into the jazz thing. And they were into Buddy Holly and that kind of a thing. I mean Ronnie Dio was from Cortland. I mean Ronnie Padavona, but he went with Ronnie Dio. I don’t know if you remember him with Black Sabbath? He passed away a couple of years ago. And there were several famous musicians from Cortland. I mean Ray…
